verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
story: David wrote this psalm after the prophet Nathan confronted him over Bathsheba, and he does not make excuses.

He asks for more than pardon. He asks God to create a clean heart in him, using the verb the Bible reserves for God's own acts, as when He made the heavens. A clean heart cannot be produced by trying harder; it must be given. David also asks for a renewed, steady spirit within him. He knows the trouble is inside, and only God can remake what is inside.
If you are carrying something you wish you had not done, bring it to Him honestly. He delights to make a heart new.
